name: OpenCode
tagline: The open-source, provider-agnostic AI coding agent for your terminal, IDE, or desktop.
description: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent from Anomaly, the team behind SST. It runs in the terminal, a desktop app, or an IDE extension, connects to 75+ model providers through Models.dev — frontier APIs and local models alike — and stores none of your code on external servers. The optional paid Zen gateway adds a curated, benchmarked model set under one bill.
insight: Built by Anomaly, the SST team; passed 160K GitHub stars and 7.5M monthly developers within a year of its June 2025 launch.

modelSupport.notes: 75+ providers via Models.dev, including local models; optional Zen plan with a curated, benchmarked set.

edge: Fully open-source and provider-agnostic where most agent CLIs are vendor-locked — swap among 75+ providers, including local models.
pros: Swap among many providers and local models
No code stored on external servers
